query: Current fill percentage/storage of Lázaro Cárdenas (El Palmito) dam in Durango Mexico from Conagua SINA, latest daily readings for July 2026 and late June 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on the Lázaro Cárdenas ("El Palmito") dam:

**Current status (most recent reading, July 8, 2026): ~21% of capacity** — a critical low, driven by 2026 agricultural-cycle extractions and weak inflows from the upper Nazas basin.

**2026 trajectory:**
- **July 8, 2026:** ~21% (inflow 44 m³/s vs. release 109 m³/s to Las Tórtolas)
- **June 19, 2026:** 25.87% = 765 Mm³ (losing ~7 Mm³/day)
- **June 1, 2026:** 31.0% = 915.948 Mm³ (seasonal peak)
- **Late April 2026:** 21.1% = 624.9 Mm³ (pre-rainy-season low)

The reservoir bottomed near 21% in spring, recovered modestly to ~31% by June 1, then declined back to ~21% by early July as irrigation withdrawals resumed. Gates were expected to close in the last week of July 2026.

**Capacity:** NAMO ~2,770.5 Mm³ (physical capacity 2,873 hm³).

**Historical context:** July 2026's ~21% is among the lowest on record — just above the 2024 historic low (18.4%) and well below typical recent years (2023: 53.6%, 2020: 46.8%, 2018: 72.3%).

**Key caveat:** The official Conagua SINA "Monitoreo de Presas" web app couldn't be scraped directly (JavaScript-based with anti-bot protection), so all figures come from news outlets citing Conagua's daily hydrometric reports. No reading later than July 8, 2026 was available as of the research date.

key_facts: As of July 8, 2026, Lázaro Cárdenas 'El Palmito' dam stood at ~21% of capacity per Conagua's hydrometric report (Milenio).
On June 19, 2026 the reservoir held 765 Mm³ = 25.87% of capacity, losing ~7 Mm³/day to agricultural extractions.
On June 1, 2026 storage was 915.948 Mm³ = 31.0% of capacity (Conagua report via POSTA).
In late April 2026 the reservoir was at a spring low of 21.1% / 624.9 Mm³ before partial recovery.
Total operational capacity (NAMO) is ~2,770.5 Mm³; physical/total capacity cited as 2,873 hm³ (Wikipedia/CONAGUA) up to ~2,957.6 Mm³.
On July 8, 2026 inflows were only 44 m³/s versus 109 m³/s released to the Las Tórtolas (Francisco Zarco) regulating dam.
750 Mm³ was allocated/extracted for the 2026 agricultural cycle; dam gates expected to close last week of July 2026.
A June 19 projection estimated the reservoir could end the 2026 cycle near ~565 Mm³.
July 2026 level (~21%) is among the lowest on record, above the 2024 historic low of 18.4% but below most recent years (2023: 53.6%, 2020: 46.8%).
The official source is Conagua's SINA 'Monitoreo de Presas' app; news outlets relay its daily readings.
